# `aitbc trade health`

Check the health of inter-chain trading for a chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade health [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | Chain ID to check |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade health --chain-id <chain_id>
```
